##### The cost of Treating Everyone Fairly: The Effect of Resampling Methods as a Fairness Mitigation Strategy on the Performance of Prediction Models Across Different Subgroups

> Currently, I am writing my master's thesis about fairness in clinical prediction models. I write the thesis under the supervision of Anne De Hond and Maarten Van Smeden at the Department of Biostatistics and Data Science at the University Medical Center Utrecht. 

##### Bayesian Evidence Synthesis (BES): Impact of Effect Harmonization on Evidence Aggregation

> I am doing an research internship at the Methodology, Statistics and Data Science Department at Utrecht University where I work together with Alfons Edmar and Irene Klugkist on Effect Size Harmonization in Bayesian Evidence Synthesis.
